policy: Persona fields (title, role, triggers, body) stay authoritative. ECC items are references only. ian-sync never imports ECC prompt text. Persona prompts get a WORKING STANDARDS section written in our own words (sync/standards/<key>.md); ECC text is never pasted into personas.
